Oracle Fusion Supply Chain & Manufacturing 26C: what changed

We track 25 Supply Chain & Manufacturing changes in 26C, out of 239 features (our count) in Oracle's 26C What's New documents for this area. 24 of them are delivered switched on; 1 need setup or an opt-in before anyone can use them.

Oracle sources: Demand Management 26C What's New · Inventory Management 26C What's New · Maintenance 26C What's New · Manufacturing 26C What's New · Order Management 26C What's New · Product Lifecycle Management 26C What's New · Supply Chain Collaboration 26C What's New · Supply Planning 26C What's New · Sales and Operations Planning 26C What's New

Impact ratings are our editorial view of how much a change affects day-to-day users and testing. Always confirm details on the linked Oracle page.

Delivered switched on (24)

Clock In and Clock Out of Work Order Operations in My Maintenance Work

Impact: highAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingMaintenance · Maintenance
In organizations using advanced scheduling, maintenance technicians can now clock in and out of work order operations in My Maintenance Work. The first clock-in starts the operation automatically, and it's marked complete once every assigned technician has finished.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Use a Separate Operation to Track Rework in a Standard or Nonstandard Discrete Manufacturing Work Order

Impact: highAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingManufacturing · Discrete ManufacturingRedwood Platform
Discrete manufacturing work orders can now include a separate rework operation. Supervisors move rejected quantities to it and track rework progress and costs in the same work order, without completing into inventory and opening a new work order. Redwood pages only.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

AI Agent: Order Exception Assistant Enhancements

Impact: highAutomatically on (setup may apply)Supply Chain & ManufacturingOrder Management · Order ManagementAI agent
You can now resolve selected fulfillment, functional, and technical order exceptions directly from the Oracle Exception Assistant. You can also review affected orders and lines, understand why processing stopped, and take guided actions such as processing pending fulfillment responses, canceling eligible tasks, recovering orders, checking availability, or continuing orchestration.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Redwood: Manage Order Promising Demands from External Source Systems

Impact: highAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingOrder Management · Global Order PromisingRedwood Platform
You can use the Redwood user experience to manage order promising for sales order lines collected from an order management system. Use search criteria to filter and select order lines, then prioritize and schedule them in required sequence.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

AI Agentic App: Inventory Planning Command Center

Impact: mediumAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Replenishment Planning
You can now use the AI agentic application named Inventory Planning Command Center to quickly analyze replenishment plan stockouts and receive actionable recommendations to resolve them.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Create Work Orders with Find Numbers for Substituted Components

Impact: mediumAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Supply Chain Orchestration
Supply Chain Orchestration now supports receiving find numbers for substituted components from Oracle Supply Chain Planning and passing them to Oracle Manufacturing during work order creation.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Calculate Planning Percentages for Product Families

Impact: mediumAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Demand Management
Demand Management can now forecast at product-family level: it calculates planning percentages from history and splits family forecasts down to items, and Supply Planning can consume the forecast at item or family level. You switch it on per plan.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Manage Analysis Sets Using a New User Experience

Impact: mediumAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Demand Management
You can now create, edit, delete, and apply analysis sets from the Visualizations and Analysis Sets page in Redwood. Analysis sets let you save commonly used measures and members and apply them to tables and graphs or use them as focused data views without creating filters.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Manage Analysis Sets Using a New User Experience

Impact: mediumAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Replenishment Planning
You can now create, edit, delete, and apply analysis sets from the Visualizations and Analysis Sets page in Redwood. Analysis sets let you save commonly used measures and members and apply them to tables and graphs or use them as focused data views without creating filters.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Manage Stacked Visualizations Using a New User Experience

Impact: mediumAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Demand Management
Stacked Visualizations lets you assemble multiple analytic layers, such as line, stacked bar, area, scatter, waterfall graphs, and pivot-table snapshots, into one composite view.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Manage Stacked Visualizations Using a New User Experience

Impact: mediumAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Replenishment Planning
Stacked Visualizations lets you assemble multiple analytic layers, such as line, stacked bar, area, scatter, waterfall graphs, and pivot-table snapshots, into one composite view.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Set Up Waterfall and Trend Analyses and Plan Comparisons Using a New User Experience

Impact: mediumAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Demand Management
Waterfall analyses, trend analyses and plan comparisons, previously set up in the classic interface, can now be configured on the Comparison tab of Redwood planning tables and graphs.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Set Up Waterfall and Trend Analyses and Plan Comparisons Using a New User Experience

Impact: mediumAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Replenishment Planning
Waterfall analyses, trend analyses and plan comparisons, previously set up in the classic interface, can now be configured on the Comparison tab of Redwood planning tables and graphs.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Create and Manage Follow Up Work Orders in My Maintenance Work

Impact: mediumAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingMaintenance · Maintenance
Maintenance technicians can now create and manage follow-up work orders directly from a source work order to track additional maintenance issues discovered during or after execution.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Edit Work Orders from My Maintenance Work

Impact: mediumAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingMaintenance · Maintenance
Maintenance technicians can now edit work order details directly from My Maintenance Work , Preview Work , and Report Work pages. This enhancement provides in-context access to the Edit Work Order page, so technicians can make updates without leaving their current workflow.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Use Kanban Planning to Manage Just-in-Time Material Replenishment

Impact: mediumAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingManufacturing · Flow ManufacturingRedwood Platform
New Kanban plans calculate the right number of Kanban cards or bin size for each pull sequence from an external forecast and pull sequence attributes (average daily demand, lead time, safety stock), and can then update the pull sequences.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Create Transfer Orders with Header Level Descriptive Flexfields

Impact: lowAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Supply Chain Orchestration
Use the Oracle Supply Chain Orchestration Supply Requests REST API and the Supply Order Import FBDI template to create transfer orders with header level descriptive flexfields.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Compare a Plan to its Archived Versions Using a New User Experience

Impact: lowAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Demand Management
You can now use the Redwood interface to compare a plan to its archived versions. You can select a total of three plans and archived versions.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Compare a Plan to its Archived Versions Using a New User Experience

Impact: lowAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Replenishment Planning
You can now use the Redwood interface to compare a plan to its archived versions. You can select a total of three plans and archived versions.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Create Link to AI Agents Using a New User Experience

Impact: lowAutomatically on (setup may apply)Supply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Demand Management
You can use the Redwood user experience to add, edit, and manage AI Agents as links tied to specific visualization, such as a table or a graph. The links can be reused across plans that include the visualization and can be edited or deleted by the link owner.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Redwood: Deep Links to Planning Pages and Visualizations with Context

Impact: lowAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Replenishment Planning
You can now navigate between planning pages using deep links that preserve context such as plan, page, page group, visualization, and filter details. It improves analysis efficiency by directly accessing relevant pages or visualizations with up to five filter context values applied.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Needs setup or opt-in (1)

Manage Organizations for Global Work Definitions Using File-Based Data Import

Impact: mediumOpt-in, expires 26DSupply Chain & ManufacturingMaintenance · Maintenance
Work definitions are defined at the maintenance organization level based on organization-specific work areas, work centers, material items, and resources. In this update, if you have work definitions with the same scope across multiple maintenance organizations, you can manage them globally.
Oracle's own impact label: None · Action to enable: Opt In plus Setup · Oracle source
